purpose: Provenance of every vendored runtime artifact under skills/scope/engine/symbols/scripts/vendor/. Regenerate by re-fetching the listed npm packages in a scratch dir and recomputing sha256.
notes: All artifacts were fetched with `npm install web-tree-sitter tree-sitter-typescript tree-sitter-python` into a scratch dir outside the repo (%TEMP%/opencode/scope-symbols-vendor); only the files listed above were copied into vendor/. The scratch project and node_modules are never committed.
Every grammar WASM is a prebuilt artifact shipped inside its npm package; no tree-sitter CLI `build --wasm` step was required.

web-tree-sitter.js was renamed to web-tree-sitter.mjs: the repo has no package.json, so Node would treat a bare .js file as CommonJS and fail on this ESM module. Content is byte-identical to upstream web-tree-sitter.js (same sha256).
Runtime/grammar pairing verified green by scripts/test/parsers.test.mjs on Node v22.14.0: web-tree-sitter@0.26.13 + tree-sitter-typescript@0.23.2 + tree-sitter-python@0.25.0.
M4 will add go/rust/java/c# grammars into grammars/ following this same manifest format.

M4 (2026-08-24): tree-sitter-go@0.25.0, tree-sitter-rust@0.24.0, tree-sitter-java@0.23.5, tree-sitter-c-sharp@0.23.5 fetched with `npm install` into %TEMP%/opencode/scope-symbols-m4-vendor; all four ship prebuilt .wasm at package root (no tree-sitter CLI `build --wasm` needed). Pairing with web-tree-sitter@0.26.13 verified by hello-world smoke parses: go/rust root source_file, java root program, c_sharp root compilation_unit.
